stratagems.name: Synaptic Imperative
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS SYNAPSE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, friendly TYRANIDS units within 12" of your unit have the Objective Secured ability (if they already have it, they count as 2 additional models when determining control).

stratagems.name: Lurk in the Shadows
stratagems.when: Opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability and a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS MONSTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of that attack.

stratagems.name: Acid Blood
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit makes its attacks.
stratagems.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was targeted.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each model in your unit that was destroyed by melee attacks this phase: on a 4+, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound.
